jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior PowerBuilder Developer
jobs.description:
Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.
Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.

• Analyse application components and dependencies, including Pbls, Powerscript, Pfc, Datawindows and Datastores.

• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.

• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including Embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.

• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.

• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.

• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.

• Advanced Powerscript and Pfc knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (Sqlca, Commit, Rollback), complex Datawindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and Datastores.

• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.

• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, MicroServices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON Dtos. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.

• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.

• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

Job description
 

As Purchasing & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping our purchasing and logistics operations running smoothly. You will ensure that the materials and components our teams need are ordered on time, that deliveries are properly received and processed, and that outgoing shipments are prepared accurately and efficiently.
 

Your responsibilities cover the entire operational flow, from placing purchase orders and coordinating with suppliers to checking incoming invoices and preparing shipments for customers and partners. When products are unavailable or delivery dates change, you take the initiative to find suitable alternatives and keep things moving.
 

In addition to the above, you will also contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of our office by taking care of a range of general and very practical facility and office management tasks.
 

This is a hands-on role combining practical warehouse and logistics activities with administrative & office-related responsibilities. We are therefore looking for someone who works proactively, takes ownership of their responsibilities and naturally spots what needs to be done. You enjoy bringing structure to day-to-day operations, solving practical problems and making sure things get done without having to be asked twice.
 

More details in PDF file enclosed.
 

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a practical approach to problem-solving.
 

You have:
 

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain, warehouse administration or a comparable operational role. 
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English, both written and spoken). 
• Strong administrative skills and an eye for detail, particularly when handling orders, delivery documents and invoices. 
• The ability to organise your work independently, set priorities and follow up on outstanding tasks. 
• A proactive mindset: you identify what needs attention, anticipate potential issues and take action without waiting for instructions. 
• A solution-oriented attitude and the ability to find practical alternatives when things do not go according to plan. 
• The flexibility to switch between administrative tasks and hands-on operational work throughout the day. 
• Confidence in communicating with suppliers, couriers, colleagues and other external contacts. 
• A reliable and structured approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, follow-up and getting things done. 
• A willingness to take ownership of both the bigger picture and the smaller practical details that keep an organisation running smoothly.
 

You are comfortable working at a desk when the task requires it, but you are equally happy to receive deliveries, check goods and take care of practical logistics activities. You understand that a well-functioning operation depends on both accurate administration and effective execution.
 

Given the practical and on-site nature of this role, you live within maximum 30 minutes' driving distance of our workplace in Hasselt.
 

Experience with purchase order systems, ERP software, courier platforms and international shipping documentation is an advantage.
